title: Depreciation Export / Audit Visibility Hardening

files_changed.rationale: New module: _resolve_depreciation_runtime_authority (reads flag snapshot from provenance_metadata or live project_inputs via app.persistence.provenance.runtime_flag_snapshot) and build_depreciation_audit_dataframe (builds the (Field, Value) DataFrame for the new sheet). Pure read-side / disclosure code. No write to model / runtime.

Three small additions: (1) from app.depreciation_audit_visibility import build_depreciation_audit_dataframe import. (2) New _write_depreciation_audit_sheet(writer, project_inputs, provenance_metadata) helper that writes a text-only Depreciation Audit sheet. (3) Wire-up call in build_excel_export immediately after the existing Book Depreciation Disclosure call. CRLF / LF line endings preserved (the file uses a mixed convention on main).

23 new design-contract tests pinning: sheet existence in both factory exports (TUHO, Oborovo); required disclosure fields; flag status disclosure; helper-text-only invariant; numeric invariance (TUHO and Oborovo existing sheet sums unchanged); existing sheets still present; no feature flag enabled; rc1 frozen; phase plan + hard no-go.
7-section design + change doc with full sheet wording table and pre-merge audit summary.

new_export_sheet.name: Depreciation Audit
new_export_sheet.location_in_export: Immediately after Book Depreciation sheet, before Phase 5D overlay sheets

exact_disclosure_wording.Phase: D1 — Depreciation Export / Audit Visibility Hardening
exact_disclosure_wording.Scope: Audit visibility only. NO runtime enablement. NO formula / schedule / tax / P&L / CFADS change.
exact_disclosure_wording.Notice: Depreciation export visibility only — no runtime authority change.
exact_disclosure_wording.Values_Reflect: Current active backend runtime path (NOT a canonical-promotion simulation).
exact_disclosure_wording.Audit_Only_Surfaces: Depreciation Assumptions; Depreciation Audit (this sheet); canonical audit rows when present in result._canonical_depreciation_wiring (advisory only, not runtime authority).
exact_disclosure_wording.Runtime_Surfaces: Tax_Depreciation; Tax Depreciation; Book Depreciation; waterfall period.depreciation_keur (when produced by the active runtime path).
exact_disclosure_wording.Known_Limitations: Canonical DepreciationEngine is not runtime-authoritative unless explicitly enabled. Audit values from the canonical engine, when present, are advisory and do NOT change the waterfall output. Generic-project depreciation claims are NOT supported. Depreciation visibility is consolidated only for the active runtime path.
exact_disclosure_wording.Generic_Project_Support: NO — depreciation runtime authority for generic (non-TUHO, non-Oborovo) projects is out of scope for the active runtime path. This audit sheet applies to the current active path only.

numeric_invariance.Depreciation_Audit_new_sheet: text-only (auto-index column only, no financial value)

recommended_next_step: Phase D2 (flag discipline hardening) or Phase D3 (shadow validation), gated on D1 review. Or alternative tracks: pause and review the depreciation arc, defer until TUHO/Oborovo G20/R99/R102 posture changes, or focus on a different governance arc.

stop_after_report_contract.rationale: D1 is the first of three safe next steps recommended by PR #530 (depreciation enablement readiness review). D1 is purely audit visibility; no runtime enablement. User review of the disclosure wording and the no-runtime-change guarantees is required before any further depreciation work begins.
